# phodex-web

> Bun + Vite + Vue recreation of the `remodex` mobile app. Current truth: local email OTP, HTTPS/WSS relay, and Codex app-server chat bridge are real; UI parity and many source-app flows are still incomplete. Read linked files progressively instead of loading the full repo context at once.

Important notes:

- The goal is source-driven mobile-app reconstruction, not a browser page wrapped in fake phone hardware.
- Do not assume pixel parity has been reached.
- Every code change in this repo should be committed intentionally.
- Commit messages should be primarily in Chinese. Keep commands, paths, code symbols, and proper nouns in English when that is clearer.

## Start Here

- [Root agent guide](./AGENTS.md): Global rules and the default reading order.
- [Start here](./docs/ai/00-start-here.md): Minimal project truth for first-pass context.
- [Product decisions](./docs/ai/05-product-decisions.md): High-priority scope rules. No QR login. No end-to-end encryption.
- [Context manifest](./docs/ai/context-manifest.yaml): Machine-readable disclosure map and task router.
